messages.content: We leave in five days. Check the Charleston flights, hotel, and both airport rides against each other. I have a note saying late Thursday arrival, which doesn’t sound right. Make sure every reservation is for three people and give me one final itinerary.

The Thursday note is incorrect. Your outbound is Friday, March 27, departing O’Hare at 8:20 a.m. and arriving Charleston at 11:31 a.m. The hotel begins Friday for four nights, so those dates align. I’m checking the return and transfer details now.
Also confirm what we do if the room isn’t ready when we get there.

Hyatt House confirmed the reservation is for Marcus, Daniel, and Owen in a king studio with a full-size sofa bed. Standard check-in is 3:00 p.m.; early check-in is only a request, but the front desk will store all three passengers’ luggage at no charge. There is no Thursday-night room needed.
What’s wrong with the rides? I thought both were handled.

They were timed but never actually reserved. I can schedule Friday pickup at CHS for 12:00 p.m. and Tuesday pickup at Hyatt House for 3:15 p.m. Both should be entered for three passengers with three standard suitcases. Should I complete those?
Yes. Do that, and make sure Tuesday is based on the later return flight.

Done. Both rides are scheduled for three passengers and three suitcases. Friday pickup is at 12:00 p.m. in the CHS rideshare pickup zone; Tuesday pickup is at 3:15 p.m. outside the Hyatt House main entrance. Tuesday is tied to the 5:45 p.m. nonstop, not the canceled earlier return.
Give me the complete version with confirmations, cancellation terms, and who to contact.

Final Charleston itinerary, March 27-31:

Friday: ORD-CHS nonstop, 8:20-11:31 a.m., confirmation H7Q4LM. Marcus, Daniel, and Owen are ticketed. At CHS, follow signs to the rideshare pickup zone; scheduled pickup is 12:00 p.m., ride confirmation R-48271, for three passengers and three suitcases. Driver details will appear in the ride app shortly before pickup; use in-app support for changes.

Hotel: Hyatt House Charleston/Historic District, confirmation HH-729461, March 27-31, four nights. King studio with full-size sofa bed, occupancy confirmed for three. Standard check-in is 3:00 p.m.; if the room is not ready, check bags with the front desk. Total is $1,454.64, payable at the hotel. Free cancellation ends March 25 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern; afterward the penalty is $363.66. Contact the hotel through the number shown in confirmation HH-729461.

Tuesday: hotel pickup at 3:15 p.m. from the main entrance, ride confirmation R-48296, for three passengers and three suitcases. CHS-ORD nonstop departs 5:45 p.m. and arrives 7:21 p.m., confirmation A6N9RP; seats are 17A, 17B, and 17C. The original return is canceled and its $501 refund remains pending. Airline changes must be handled through the carrier app or the contact number attached to the relevant confirmation. Scheduled rides can be canceled without charge until one hour before pickup; later cancellation may incur the quoted fare.
